meta.title: Peak reminder
meta.description: Shows a status dot in the conversation header for DeepSeek's price schedule: red with a pulse during peak hours, amber in the 30 minutes before peak starts, and green during off-peak. Click the dot for a countdown, a 24-hour ribbon whose peak change points are hoverable, and the schedule in your local time zone; a one-time toast announces when a peak begins. The card also carries two switches: desktop notifications when a reply or a question arrives, and right-to-left layout for messages, session titles, multi-choice questions, and the allow-once/reject approval prompt, with code kept left to right. A usage cell in the sidebar foot reports this session's input, cached, and output tokens, decode speed, turn time, and an estimated cost at the current rate, with the account's remaining balance in a separate band below. Peak is Monday to Friday, 01:00–04:00 and 06:00–10:00 UTC, excluding Chinese public holidays. The schedule refreshes itself from schedule.json and from DeepSeek's official pricing page; when those sources fail, the built-in windows keep working. The plugin reads no session content.
